benefit: Beans fix nitrogen + climb cornstalks; squash/pumpkin vines suppress weeds at the ground layer.

members.title: Three Sisters: plant beans (corn at ~6 in)
members.body: Plant pole beans 6 in from each cornstalk. Avoid before corn reaches 6 in.

members.title: Three Sisters: plant pumpkins on outer hills
members.body: Plant pumpkin hills at outer block edges so vines do not shade young corn or beans.
